usage: deskops atoms proto [-h] --title TITLE [--content CONTENT]
                           [--tag TAG [TAG ...]] [--root ROOT]
                           doc_id

positional arguments:
  doc_id               New protoatom id, conventionally proto-<slug>.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE        Short title of the free knowledge unit.
  --content CONTENT    Free markdown content.
  --tag TAG [TAG ...]  Atom tag; a single domain:<path> tag places the
                       protoatom in the domain tree.
  --root ROOT          Target repository root.
